reader_summary.headline: Hello and welcome to Behind the Memo with Howard Marks.
reader_summary.overview: Hello and welcome to Behind the Memo with Howard Marks. Today, Howard and I are joined by a special guest, Edward Chancellor, the journalist, financial historian, and author of multiple books. Howard's latest memo, Easy Money, was inspired by the price of time.

thesis: Howard Marks and Edward Chancellor argue that interest rates function as the price of time, serving as a critical mechanism to coordinate savings, investments, and consumption across different time periods. They contend that maintaining interest rates at zero or negative levels effectively turns the clock back, corrupting the economic and financial system by distorting valuations and encouraging behaviors like hyper-speculation and the rise of zombie companies.
